reasons: The finding is correctly characterised as 'missing': the only liability language (p0027) is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages with indemnity and confidentiality carve-outs, and no monetary or aggregate cap exists, so both parties' direct liability is unlimited — a critical gap under LOL-CAP.

The redline is additive and minimal: it leaves existing subsection (a) untouched and inserts a new (b) tracking the model language — mutual 'each party's total aggregate liability', greater-of twelve months' amounts and USD 1,000,000, and the full Excluded Claims set (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP infringement), plus preservation of payment obligations outside the cap.

The substitution of 'aggregate amounts paid or payable under this Agreement' for 'fees paid or payable by Customer' is a defensible adaptation to the revenue-share commercial model, and the USD 1,000,000 floor prevents the cap from being illusory; it does not create one-sidedness or fall into the walk-away zone.

The comment accurately describes the gap, what was added, the playbook position, that indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap, and offers the straight twelve-month fallback; tone and prefix conform.

Deterministic checks all pass (cap references 12 months plus fixed floor; no residual unlimited-Customer-liability language). Only cosmetic nit: the inserted subsection mixes all-caps and sentence case, which is stylistic and not disqualifying.
